normal_quit_result.scope: One-region normal SceneTree quit with production ground cover alive; isolated lifecycle discriminator only. Full-world e006 shutdown blocker remains OPEN.

findings.subject: WaterSurface noise
findings.evidence: Three 256x256 NoiseTexture2D resources are configured once synchronously before deferred generation. Locked Godot coalesces queued updates and forces first generation synchronous; worker tasks are used on subsequent updates. No later noise mutation found in WaterSurface/offshore material path.
findings.conclusion: Destructor can wait on a pending task, but constructor presence alone does not establish an asynchronous task or join stall. Do not remove water noise or worker joins speculatively.
findings.limit: Source inference, not captured task state; rendering texture release still untested in fixture.

findings.subject: WorldLook dependency closure
findings.evidence: WorldLook preloads playground_world for static aerial-fade/wetness setters; no construction follows from that preload. It also preloads character/creature classes with lazy resource caches.
findings.conclusion: Do not equate preload closure with an instantiated second world or allocated lazy caches. Full-world static/imported-resource lifetime remains unisolated.

findings.subject: Renderer configuration gap
findings.evidence: Failed raw metadata confirms Medium, Forward+, GTX1060 3GB and 1920x1080. It does not contain effective Environment properties, actual Terrain residency or actual MultiMesh node count. Passing fixture has no WorldEnvironment or lights and uses 320x180.
findings.conclusion: Matching rendering-method alone does not cover full-world sky, SSAO, volumetric fog, glow, shadow/render-target lifetimes. Config requests Medium fog/SSAO/glow with SSIL off; those are source settings, not captured effective readbacks.

findings.subject: Scale gap
findings.evidence: The full-world log reports 4163 authored placements in 558 model batches, besides the exact same 47612 procedural instances as passing isolation. Config/resource file counts are not runtime residency; batch count is not MultiMesh node count.
findings.conclusion: Record measured runtime counts before selecting scale. No linear extrapolation of isolated cover deletion time.
